title: CreditPilot: AI underwriting co-pilot for NBFCs

source.ref: An AI co-pilot that reads bank statements, bureau data and GST returns and drafts a credit memo for MSME loans in minutes.

walkaway.note: Will not go below ₹30 crore valuation; prefers a shark who opens NBFC doors.

brief: Seed-stage B2B SaaS. 6 NBFC pilots, 3 paying. ARR ₹2.4 crore, 78% gross margin, burn ₹28 lakh a month, 9 months runway. Cuts MSME credit turnaround from 3 days to 4 hours.
assumptions: Pilot NBFCs keep using the product after the free period (assumed)
Founders have not yet completed an external model-risk audit (assumed)
